verdicts.evidence: Exact computation over 432 configurations shows 0 violations of the Theorem 3.2 bound when B≥2·B_min, with error decaying from 7.76e-01 to 1.60e-28 over a 128× budget range (linear fit R²=0.983); Monte Carlo cross-check (5 seeds × 200k runs) matches exact error within 2.9e-04; mutation tests confirm the doubly-exponential schedule is load-bearing.

Deterministic integer bisection over 420 grid points (A up to 10⁶, δ down to 10⁻¹⁰) shows max B_req/F = 24.41 as a single constant, with per-A maximum non-increasing across 6 orders of magnitude in A; mutation test dropping the inner logarithm shows unbounded growth (factor 6.91 blow-up), confirming the log factor is necessary.

Exhaustive enumeration of the full multinomial support over 8 target δ values shows 0 violations of Propositions 4.2 and 4.3; strongness verified by fitting T*_δ = L·f(δ₀) yielding slope 578.07 vs predicted 577.08 (R²=0.99993); simulation matches exact computation to 2.4e-20; mutation test replacing majority voting shows error jumping to 0.9935 with no decay.

Phase lengths T_i = 2^i·Q depend only on (i,Q) with standing recommendation verified for all t∈[1,5000); Props D.3/D.4 show 0 violations over 80,004 consecutive horizons; Theorem D.5 bound has 0 violations over 21 pairs with error falling by factor 4.29e9; mutation tests show constant phases stall error at 1.0 and sub-geometric growth breaks Prop D.4.

Heterogeneous-noise (Cor 5.2) is supported by Monte Carlo runs of the real PE-KHN algorithm inside FC2FB showing monotone error decay and K⁷ vs K⁹ separation confirmed via sympy, but linear bandits (Cor 5.4) and unimodal bandits (Cor 5.7) were not attempted due to dependence on external algorithms (Katz-Samuels et al. 2020, UniTT), leaving two of three sub-claims unaddressed.

overall: The logbook provides strong computational verification of Claims 1–4 through exact arithmetic, exhaustive enumeration, Monte Carlo cross-checks, and mutation tests across wide parameter grids. Claim 5 is only partially addressed: the heterogeneous-noise application is verified with real algorithm runs, but the linear and unimodal applications are not attempted due to external dependencies.
